name: @pwfabric/foundation
description: PWFabric Foundation - the standard library of the PWFabric spec: the core block vocabulary (layout, text, controls, forms, data, feedback, media), the top-bar, bottom-bar and chrome-less shells with their page parts, two reference themes, the icon dictionary, four capabilities and the REST connector. Self-contained: every block is placed on its own showcase pages.

scripts.test: node scripts/check-pwpack-json.mjs && node scripts/check-integrity.mjs && node scripts/audit-fabrications.mjs && vitest run
